consequence.statement: On-deployed notifications will now be delivered in scenarios where sync completes without changing application health status, whereas previously they were suppressed in such cases.

original.statement: Argo CD now delivers on-deployed notifications when a sync operation completes without changing the application's health status.

decision.reason: [ev-86b636e38d6e] is a bug-fix changelog entry: on-deployed notifications "would now be delivered" when a sync did not change the app's health status. That means extra notifications get sent where none were sent before. Nothing fails, gets rejected or needs migrating, so behavior-change (review) with low severity fits, and the proposed statement matches the evidence.
